# Purpose
This R script performs basic data analysis using tidyverse tools.  
It loads data, cleans it, and produces summary statistics and visualizations.

# Inputs
- Raw dataset (e.g., `data.csv`)
- Required R packages:
  - tidyverse
  - ggplot2
  - dplyr

# Outputs
- Cleaned dataset
- Summary statistics
- Plots (histograms, scatterplots, etc.)
- Analysis report

# Example Code

```r
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)

# Read data
data <- read.csv("data.csv")

# Clean data
clean_data <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

# Summary statistics
summary(clean_data)
```
